title: Resetting a chiming clock
passage:
F: The clock in the hall chimes in the middle of the night. I thought we’d set it to ring only during the day.
M: The switch is still on daytime mode. I changed the battery yesterday, and I only set the hands. The little dial at the back tells it whether it’s morning or evening. I must have left that twelve hours off.
F: Can we just switch the chime off?
M: You can, but it won’t ring at all then. Let me fix the dial first. If it’s right, it should ring at six this evening and stay quiet overnight.
passageZh:
F: 走廊的鐘半夜會響。我以為我們已經設定成只在白天報時了。
M: 開關還在白天模式。我昨天換了電池，只調了指針。背面的小轉盤用來區分上午和下午。我應該把那個轉盤設錯了，差了十二小時。
F: 我們乾脆把報時聲關掉好嗎？
M: 可以，但這樣它就完全不會報時了。我先把轉盤調好。如果設定正確，今天傍晚六點就會響，夜裡則會保持安靜。
